results.title:
“What’s the best dog breed for first-time owners?”

I get asked this all the time.

If you want a dog that’s eager to please, relatively easy to train, good with children, and generally forgiving while you’re learning… start simple.

A Labrador Retriever
A Golden Retriever
Or if you want something a little different, a Flat-Coated Retriever

They’re not perfect — no breed is — but they tend to be biddable, social, and far more accommodating of first-time mistakes than many others.

Breed choice won’t replace good training…
But the right breed can make the learning curve a lot smoother.

Choose wisely.
